answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The kernel of work and the sonnet of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a walnut to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
